component.name: ZEBU Slicer
component.summary: FDM slicer forked from OrcaSlicer, with per-machine presets and a live printer panel

description.p: ZEBU Slicer is a fork of OrcaSlicer. It keeps OrcaSlicer's slicing engine and adds presets bound to a single machine, import of OrcaSlicer presets, a live panel showing the printers' camera and temperatures (Moonraker), and a more parallel code path.
OrcaSlicer is developed by SoftFever and the OrcaSlicer contributors.
